title: Converging normal averages force positive mass on every ball
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P, ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P and y, v ∈ ℝ^P with v ≠ 0. Let A(ρ) := μ(B̄_ρ(y))_ℝ^{-1} ∫_{B̄_ρ(y)} ν dμ, where μ(·)_ℝ = ENNReal.toReal, 0^{-1} = 0 and the integral is the Bochner integral. Suppose A(ρ) → v as ρ → 0⁺ (filter 𝓝[>] 0). Then μ(B̄_r(y)) ≠ 0 for every r > 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P) (y v : Euclid P), v ≠ 0 → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, ν z ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μ (closedBall y r) ≠ 0
